payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_size.py::test_files_under_the_declared_test_paths_are_left_out_of_the_count stayed green with the spec's wrong version "A pattern's text before its first `*` matched as a substring of the path, so src/tests/util.py is left out." applied to saffron/gates/core/size.py as an edit. The claim was "`size_gate` takes the repo's declared test paths, and a file whose path matches any one of them adds nothing to the count. The verdict, the pass summary, the fail summary and the failure message all use the count without them. When files under a test path carried tokens, the summary names how many tokens they carried. When none did, the pass and fail summaries are exactly what they are today, with a rewrapped test file that carries none. An estimated file under a test path is not named as estimated. A file hidden as binary under a test path and inside `touches` is refused or named exactly as today: `error` where the gate blocks, and named in the pass summary where it does not. The witness declares two globs, tests/** and *_test.go, and changes six files. It counts src/a.py, pkg/a_test.go and src/tests/util.py. It leaves out tests/unit/test_a.py, a_test.go and a tests/shared.py past the token-diff bound. A diff over the `bug` ceiling only with its test file passes with the paths declared and fails without them. One over it on source alone fails, and its fail summary and failure message both start with the source count.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
